summary: Frontend-only verification of Master screen changes: (1) 9-button grid order and labels verified — Agenda, New Contact, Chat Gruppo, Calcolatrice, My Web, New CRT, New App, Registra audio, I miei audio (exact match). (2) Standalone MasterVoiceRecorder FAB below stats removed; no separate 'my-audios-link' row at bottom. (3) 'I miei audio' grid tap navigates to /my-audios. (4) 'Registra audio' grid tap does not crash — page stays on /master, no red screen. (5) 'My Thing' banner persistence bug FIXED — banner remains visible immediately and after 5s (test user has no My Thing images so fallback gradient with 'Aggiungi immagini motivazionali da My Thing' is displayed persistently). (6) Banner tap navigates to /my-thing. (7) Statistiche di oggi (Energy + Network cards) still render at bottom of scroll view. Login flow (test@dalpastro.it / Test1234!) works and Home → Master navigation works.
test_report_links: Playwright inline script (mobile viewport 375x667) run against https://business-card-pro-16.preview.emergentagent.com/master
critical_code_review_comments: master.tsx now ~486 lines — still within limits but Calculator sub-component (~110 lines) could be extracted to its own file to keep master.tsx focused.
Unused style keys remain in StyleSheet after removals (myAudiosLink, myAudiosLinkTxt, statsRow, statCard, statRowLine, statNum, statLbl, bannerTitle) — minor cleanup opportunity, non-blocking.
banner slideshow logic is duplicated between home.tsx and master.tsx — could be extracted into a reusable <MyThingBanner /> component in future refactor.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing owner account test@dalpastro.it. Test user has no My Thing images uploaded, so banner rendered fallback gradient (which is one of the two expected states).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Master screen refactor verified complete: 9-button grid in the expected order, banner persistence fixed, MasterVoiceRecorder now mounted invisibly with startSignal-driven trigger via 'Registra audio' grid button. Skipped real mic recording (getUserMedia fails on Playwright/web sandbox — expected). Skipped the crossfade transition visual test because test user has no My Thing images; if a next testing agent needs to verify the actual crossfade, first upload 2+ images to /my-thing via the API for the test user, then observe fade for 10s+ intervals.
rca_of_issue: N/A — original My Thing banner disappearance bug appears fixed. Fix uses local myThingImages state derived from /api/my-thing?kind=image and a currentBannerImg selector that also falls back to /my-thing/random-banner.item.image_base64 and finally to a LinearGradient fallback (the third branch is what our test user sees). Because the banner is now always rendered (Pressable never conditionally unmounts), it can no longer disappear after an initial load.
